text:
Sam: saw an odd billing blip during a canary: router downgraded model mid-stream, stream truncated, client retried and a new toolcall was created. provisional + confirmed both spiked for the tenant.
Devin: trace?
Sam: /console/trace/6111112222. logs: 
```
[router] req=orig-abc route=policy-3 -> model-lite handoff
[proxy] retry=1 toolcall=tts.start truncated=true
```
Devin: retry lacked dedupe key so ledger counted twice.
Arjun: propose internal-only headers `x-rw-origin-id` + `x-rw-route-v` propagated on handoffs. ledger dedupe if same origin+route within 2m.
Maya: console change: surface route_v in token table and add filter by origin id for support.
Devin: proxy change + tests: reject duplicate toolcall when dedupe hit (409-ish) and reuse prior result.
BillingBot: alert: provisional delta +2.1k tokens tenant=beta-inc at 6111112230
Sam: feature-flag the change, roll 10% for 48h, monitor new route_v breakdown.
Arjun: I'll draft schema + migration (origin_id string, route_v int, dedupe_key index).
Sam: great, owners: Arjun(schema), Devin(proxy), Maya(console). sync at 2pm.
